_comment: P49 WS3: operational-URL provenance sidecar. Drift invariant 46 (check_url_provenance) requires every http(s):// literal in tools/**/*.py to be accounted for by at least one of: (a) a host in source-registry.json (data/reference sources), (b) a base domain listed here (infrastructure/plumbing endpoints), or (c) an excluded-by-rule host (example/placeholder/localhost/schema namespace). This file covers bucket (b): endpoints the code calls that are NOT re-checkable data sources. Entries are BASE DOMAINS; the invariant matches a host if it equals or is a subdomain of a listed domain. Add a new endpoint here (with a reason) rather than letting an undeclared URL ship. Invariant 46 fails an entry that matches no URL host in tools/**/*.py, whose hosts are all covered by another entry here, or that is listed twice; a host the registry also covers may stay listed. Doc bibliographies (docs/**, planning JSONs) are out of scope by rule -- the guard scans executable code only.
